1.web: “When Israel was a child, then I loved him, and called my son out of Egypt.
1.asv: When Israel was a child, then I loved him, and called my son out of Egypt.

2.web: They called to them, so they went from them. They sacrificed to the Baals, and burned incense to engraved images.
2.asv: The more the prophets called them, the more they went from them: they sacrificed unto the Baalim, and burned incense to graven images.

3.web: Yet I taught Ephraim to walk. I took them by his arms; but they didn’t know that I healed them.
3.asv: Yet I taught Ephraim to walk; I took them on my arms; but they knew not that I healed them.

4.web: I drew them with cords of a man, with ties of love; and I was to them like those who lift up the yoke on their necks; and I bent down to him and I fed him.
4.asv: I drew them with cords of a man, with bands of love; and I was to them as they that lift up the yoke on their jaws; and I laid food before them.

5.web: “They won’t return into the land of Egypt; but the Assyrian will be their king, because they refused to repent.
5.asv: They shall not return into the land of Egypt; but the Assyrian shall be their king, because they refused to return to me.

6.web: The sword will fall on their cities, and will destroy the bars of their gates, and will put an end to their plans.
6.asv: And the sword shall fall upon their cities, and shall consume their bars, and devour them, because of their own counsels.

7.web: My people are determined to turn from me. Though they call to the Most High, he certainly won’t exalt them.
7.asv: And my people are bent on backsliding from me: though they call them to him that is on high, none at all will exalt him.

8.web: “How can I give you up, Ephraim? How can I hand you over, Israel? How can I make you like Admah? How can I make you like Zeboiim? My heart is turned within me, my compassion is aroused.
8.asv: How shall I give thee up, Ephraim? how shall I cast thee off, Israel? how shall I make thee as Admah? how shall I set thee as Zeboiim? my heart is turned within me, my compassions are kindled together.

9.web: I will not execute the fierceness of my anger. I will not return to destroy Ephraim: for I am God, and not man; the Holy One in your midst; and I will not come in wrath.
9.asv: I will not execute the fierceness of mine anger, I will not return to destroy Ephraim: for I am God, and not man; the Holy One in the midst of thee; and I will not come in wrath.

10.web: They will walk after Yahweh, who will roar like a lion; for he will roar, and the children will come trembling from the west.
10.asv: They shall walk after Jehovah, who will roar like a lion; for he will roar, and the children shall come trembling from the west.

11.web: They will come trembling like a bird out of Egypt, and like a dove out of the land of Assyria; and I will settle them in their houses,” says Yahweh.
11.asv: They shall come trembling as a bird out of Egypt, and as a dove out of the land of Assyria; and I will make them to dwell in their houses, saith Jehovah.

12.web: Ephraim surrounds me with falsehood, and the house of Israel with deceit. Judah still strays from God, and is unfaithful to the Holy One.
12.asv: Ephraim compasseth me about with falsehood, and the house of Israel with deceit; but Judah yet ruleth with God, and is faithful with the Holy One.
